title: Social Page
description: A user-hosted page in a decentralized social network. Post to your own page; following, unfollowing and liking are cross-Thing effects that update both your page and the other person's page through a page-id parameter.

posts.title: Posts
posts.description: Ids of the posts on this page, in posting order (post-1, post-2, ...).

postContents.title: Post Contents
postContents.description: The content of each post, in the same order as posts.

followers.title: Followers
followers.description: Page ids that follow this page.

likedPosts.title: Liked Posts
likedPosts.description: Post ids this page has liked.

postCount.title: Post Count
postCount.description: Number of posts on this page.

followerCount.title: Follower Count
followerCount.description: Number of pages following this page.

followingCount.title: Following Count
followingCount.description: Number of pages this page follows.

createPost.title: Create Post
createPost.description: Publish a post on this page. Its id is post-N, where N is the new post count.
createPost.lab:effects: posts' = posts.append("post-" + (postCount + 1)); postContents' = postContents.append(content); postCount' = postCount + 1; output.postId = "post-" + postCount'; output.postCount = postCount';

followUser.title: Follow User
followUser.description: Follow another page: add it to this page's following and add this page to its followers, updating both counts. Following a page already followed changes nothing and reports success false.
followUser.lab:effects: following' = !following.contains(pageUri) ? following.append(pageUri) : following; followingCount' = !following.contains(pageUri) ? followingCount + 1 : followingCount; pageUri.followers' = !following.contains(pageUri) ? pageUri.followers.append(this.id) : pageUri.followers; pageUri.followerCount' = !following.contains(pageUri) ? pageUri.followerCount + 1 : pageUri.followerCount; output.success = !following.contains(pageUri); output.followed = pageUri;

unfollowUser.title: Unfollow User
unfollowUser.description: Unfollow another page: remove it from this page's following and remove this page from its followers, updating both counts. Unfollowing a page not followed changes nothing and reports success false.
unfollowUser.lab:effects: following' = following.contains(pageUri) ? following.remove(pageUri) : following; followingCount' = following.contains(pageUri) ? followingCount - 1 : followingCount; pageUri.followers' = following.contains(pageUri) ? pageUri.followers.remove(this.id) : pageUri.followers; pageUri.followerCount' = following.contains(pageUri) ? pageUri.followerCount - 1 : pageUri.followerCount; output.success = following.contains(pageUri); output.unfollowed = pageUri;

likePost.title: Like Post
likePost.description: Like a post on another page: record the post id here and raise that page's likesReceived.

pageUri.description: Page id whose post is liked.

likePost.lab:effects: likedPosts' = likedPosts.append(postId); pageUri.likesReceived' = pageUri.likesReceived + 1; output.success = true; output.liked = postId;
